container_info.description: FlowQuest is an interactive educational game designed to make vector calculus and fluid dynamics concepts intuitive and engaging. Players control a particle moving through a vector field representing physical systems such as fluid flow, magnetic fields, or force fields. The player must guide the particle by entering or selecting differential equations (ODEs) that describe its motion, aiming to reach a target while avoiding obstacles and traps. The game blends learning with fun, offering real-time simulation, visualization, and gamified challenges to enhance understanding of mathematical concepts.

The container is labeled 'frontend' and the Dockerfile summary includes frontend toolchains and CLIs (nodejs, npm, yarn, typescript, create-react-app, webpack, jest) and common SPA toolchains. React (via create-react-app) is a lightweight, widely used choice for interactive, canvas/WebGL or SVG-driven simulations and integrates well with TypeScript and the listed tools, so it is the most suitable framework for this frontend environment.

steps.name: Prepare environment and persist NODE_ENV and npm global bin safely
steps.description: Validate Node (>=18) and package manager versions (npm, yarn) available in the container; atomically write a runtime-safe /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh that computes npm global bin at login without expanding the current PATH. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
PFILE="/etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh"
TMPFILE="/tmp/frontend_env.sh.$$"
MIN_NODE=18
MIN_NPM=9
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERR: node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_VER_RAW=$(node --version 2>/dev/null || "v0.0.0")
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "${NODE_VER_RAW}" | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/')
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt "$MIN_NODE" ]; then echo "ERR: node ${NODE_VER_RAW} found; requires >=v${MIN_NODE}.0.0" >&2; exit 3; fi
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERR: npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
NPM_VER_RAW=$(npm --version 2>/dev/null || "0")
NPM_MAJOR=$(echo "$NPM_VER_RAW" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "${NPM_MAJOR:-0}" -lt "$MIN_NPM" ]; then echo "ERR: npm ${NPM_VER_RAW} found; recommends >=${MIN_NPM}.x for Node ${MIN_NODE}+ (prefer upgrade)" >&2; exit 5; fi
# detect yarn major
YARN_OK=0
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  YARN_VER=$(yarn --version 2>/dev/null || "0")
  YARN_MAJOR=$(echo "$YARN_VER" | cut -d. -f1)
  if [ "${YARN_MAJOR:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then YARN_OK=2; else YARN_OK=1; fi
fi
# atomic write
sudo bash -lc "cat > '$TMPFILE' <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# FrontendContainer environment (created by setup)
export NODE_ENV=development
# compute npm global bin at login
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_GLBIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "\${NPM_GLBIN}" ]; then
    case ":\${PATH}:" in
      *":\${NPM_GLBIN}:") ;;
      *) export PATH=\"\${PATH}:\${NPM_GLBIN}\";;
    esac
  fi
fi
EOF"
sudo mv "$TMPFILE" "$PFILE" && sudo chown root:root "$PFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PFILE"
sudo grep -q "NODE_ENV=development" "$PFILE" || { sudo rm -f "$PFILE" || true; echo "ERR: profile write verification failed" >&2; exit 6; }
sudo -i bash -lc 'command -v node >/dev/null && command -v npm >/dev/null' || { echo "ERR: node/npm not available in login shell" >&2; exit 7; }
if [ "$YARN_OK" -eq 2 ]; then echo "YARN_BERRY=1" >/tmp/frontend_env.yarn.$$; else echo "YARN_BERRY=0" >/tmp/frontend_env.yarn.$$; fi
echo "ENV_OK"

steps.name: Scaffold React project using Vite (non-interactive) with offline fallback
steps.description: Create a minimal React app under WORKSPACE/app using create-vite via npx non-interactively. If npx/create-vite fails, fall back to the globally installed create-react-app. Skip if an existing React project is present. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
APPDIR="$WORKSPACE/app"
# if APPDIR exists and looks like a react app, skip
if [ -f "$APPDIR/package.json" ]; then
  if node -e 'try{process.chdir(process.argv[1]); const p=require("./package.json"); const hasReact=!!((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react)||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.react)); if(hasReact) process.exit(0); process.exit(2);}catch(e){process.exit(1);}' "$APPDIR" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "SCAFFOLD_SKIP"; exit 0
  else
    echo "ERR: $APPDIR exists but is not a React app; remove or move it before scaffolding" >&2; exit 8
  fi
fi
TMPNAME="tmp_vite_project_$$"
VITE_FAIL=0
if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ( cd "$WORKSPACE" && npx --yes create-vite@latest "$TMPNAME" --template react ) || VITE_FAIL=1
else
  VITE_FAIL=1
fi
if [ "$VITE_FAIL" -eq 0 ] && [ -d "$WORKSPACE/$TMPNAME" ]; then
  mv "$WORKSPACE/$TMPNAME" "$APPDIR" || { echo "ERR: move scaffold failed" >&2; exit 9; }
else
  if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    CRA_TMP="tmp_cra_$$"
    ( cd "$WORKSPACE" && create-react-app "$CRA_TMP" ) || { echo "ERR: global create-react-app failed" >&2; exit 10; }
    mv "$WORKSPACE/$CRA_TMP" "$APPDIR" || { echo "ERR: move CRA failed" >&2; exit 11; }
  else
    echo "SCAFFOLD_NONE"; exit 0
  fi
fi
node -e 'try{process.chdir(process.argv[1]); const p=require("./package.json"); if(!(p.scripts && (p.scripts.dev||p.scripts.start||p.scripts.build))) process.exit(2); if(!((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react)||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.react))) process.exit(3); process.exit(0);}catch(e){process.exit(4);}' "$APPDIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERR: scaffold verification failed" >&2; exit 13; }
echo "SCAFFOLD_OK"

steps.name: Install project dependencies and ensure dev tools (yarn/npm aware)
steps.description: Install project dependencies in WORKSPACE/app. Detect package manager (prefer yarn only if yarn v1; if Yarn Berry detected prefer npm). Perform lockfile-aware install and ensure devDependencies (cross-env, jest, serve) are present if project exists. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer/app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
APPDIR="$WORKSPACE/app"
if [ ! -d "$APPDIR" ] || [ ! -f "$APPDIR/package.json" ]; then echo "DEPS_SKIP"; exit 0; fi
cd "$APPDIR"
LOG=/tmp/frontend-setup.$$.log; : >"$LOG"
# detect yarn version
PM="npm"
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then YV=$(yarn -v 2>/dev/null || true); case "$YV" in 1.*) PM="yarn";; *) PM="npm";; esac; fi
# install
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then
  if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --frozen-lockfile >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 14; }; else yarn install >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 14; }; fi
else
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 14; }; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 14; }; fi
fi
[ -d node_modules ] || { cat "$LOG" >&2; echo "ERR: dependency install produced no node_modules" >&2; exit 14; }
# ensure test tooling present in package.json; only modify if project exists
pkg_has(){ node -e 'try{process.chdir("'$PWD'"); const p=require("./package.json"); const joined=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{},p.optionalDependencies||{},p.peerDependencies||{}); process.exit(joined["'$1'"]?0:1);}catch(e){process.exit(2);}' >/dev/null 2>&1; }
TO_ADD=()
pkg_has cross-env || TO_ADD+=("cross-env")
pkg_has jest || TO_ADD+=("jest")
pkg_has serve || TO_ADD+=("serve")
if [ ${#TO_ADD[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn add -D "${TO_ADD[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 15; }; yarn install --frozen-lockfile >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 16; }
  else npm i --save-dev "${TO_ADD[@]}" --no-audit --no-fund >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 15; }; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 16; }; fi
  fi
fi
# verify jest runnable locally
if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install jest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "DEPS_OK"; exit 0; fi
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/jest ]; then echo "DEPS_OK"; exit 0; fi
cat "$LOG" >&2
echo "ERR: jest not installed locally; see $LOG" >&2
exit 17

steps.name: Setup minimal tests, ensure app dir exists, and run unit tests
steps.description: Ensure WORKSPACE/app exists. If scaffold created the app, run tests. If the app directory is absent (scaffold skipped or failed), create a minimal safe project skeleton (package.json with test script and jest as devDependency), install minimal deps non-interactively, write a sanity Jest test, then run tests non-interactively. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer/app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
APPDIR="$WORKSPACE/app"
LOG=/tmp/frontend-tests.$$.log
: >"$LOG"
# ensure appdir exists: if scaffold produced it, keep; if not, create minimal skeleton to allow tests
if [ ! -d "$APPDIR" ] || [ ! -f "$APPDIR/package.json" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$APPDIR"
  cd "$APPDIR"
  # create minimal package.json if missing
  if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
    cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "frontend-minimal",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": { "test": "jest --runInBand --silent" }
}
EOF
  fi
  # install jest locally non-interactively
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev jest >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; echo "ERR: npm install jest failed" >&2; exit 30; }
  elif command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    yarn add -D jest >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; echo "ERR: yarn add jest failed" >&2; exit 31; }
  else
    echo "ERR: no package manager available" >&2; exit 32
  fi
else
  cd "$APPDIR"
fi
# write a simple sanity test
if [ -d src ]; then TESTDIR=src/__tests__; else TESTDIR=__tests__; fi
mkdir -p "$TESTDIR"
cat > "$TESTDIR/sanity.test.js" <<'EOF'
test('sanity',()=>{expect(true).toBe(true)})
EOF
# run tests: prefer npx --no-install jest then local binary
if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install jest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  npx --no-install jest --runInBand --silent 2>&1 | tee "$LOG"; EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0}
elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/jest ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand --silent 2>&1 | tee "$LOG"; EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0}
else
  # last resort: npx may install
  npx jest --runInBand --silent 2>&1 | tee "$LOG"; EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0}
fi
if [ "$EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then echo "ERR: tests failed; see $LOG" >&2; exit 33; fi
echo "TESTS_OK"

steps.name: Start project preview server (robust start and lifecycle)
steps.description: Start a preview/static server for the project on $PORT (env) default 3000. Prefer package.json scripts.preview/serve, then vite preview, then serve -s <build|dist>, or npm start. Start process under setsid, record PID/PGID and verify bind. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer/app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
APPDIR="$WORKSPACE/app"
cd "$APPDIR"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
LOG=/tmp/frontend-server.$$.log; : >"$LOG"
PIDFILE=/tmp/frontend-server.$$.pid
PGFILE=/tmp/frontend-server.$$.pgid
# check port availability
python3 - <<PY >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
import socket,sys
s=socket.socket()
try:
 s.bind(('127.0.0.1', $PORT))
 s.close(); sys.exit(0)
except OSError:
 sys.exit(1)
PY
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "PORT_IN_USE"; exit 0; fi
# determine start command
START_CMD=""
if node -e 'try{process.chdir("'"$PWD"'"); const p=require("./package.json"); process.exit(p.scripts&&(p.scripts.preview||p.scripts.serve)?0:1);}catch(e){process.exit(1);}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  SCRIPT_VAL=$(node -e 'process.chdir("'"$PWD"'"); const p=require("./package.json"); console.log(p.scripts.preview||p.scripts.serve)')
  START_CMD="bash -lc 'export PORT=$PORT; $SCRIPT_VAL'"
elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then
  START_CMD="npx vite preview --strictPort --port $PORT"
else
  if [ -d build ]; then DIR=build; elif [ -d dist ]; then DIR=dist; else DIR=""; fi
  if [ -n "$DIR" ]; then START_CMD="npx serve -s \"$DIR\" -l $PORT"; else
    if node -e 'try{process.chdir("'"$PWD"'"); const p=require("./package.json"); process.exit(p.scripts&&p.scripts.start?0:1);}catch(e){process.exit(1);}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then START_CMD="npm start"; else echo "ERR: no start method available" >&2; exit 19; fi
  fi
fi
setsid bash -lc "export PORT=$PORT; exec $START_CMD" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
SPID=$!
sleep 1
if [ -z "$SPID" ] || ! kill -0 "$SPID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERR: server did not start" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 20; fi
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SPID" | tr -d ' ')
echo "$SPID" > "$PIDFILE"; echo "$PGID" > "$PGFILE"
# poll for bind
TRIES=10
for i in $(seq 1 $TRIES); do sleep 1; if curl -sS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "STARTED"; exit 0; fi; if [ "$i" -eq "$TRIES" ]; then echo "ERR: server failed to bind" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 21; fi; done

steps.name: Build production bundle and validate server responsiveness
steps.description: Build the project (yarn build or npm run build if build script exists), start a deterministic preview server (vite preview or serve -s <outdir>), poll HTTP endpoint and capture HTTP status and first 1KB body to /tmp/frontend-validate.$$.response, then terminate server process group cleanly. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer/app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
APPDIR="$WORKSPACE/app"
cd "$APPDIR"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
RESP_FILE=/tmp/frontend-validate.$$.response
META_FILE="${RESP_FILE}.meta"
LOG=/tmp/frontend-validate.$$.log; : >"$LOG"
# build if build script exists
if node -e 'try{process.chdir("'"$PWD"'"); const p=require("./package.json"); process.exit(p.scripts&&p.scripts.build?0:1);}catch(e){process.exit(1);}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then yarn build 2>"$LOG" || { echo "ERR: build failed" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 22; }; else npm run build 2>"$LOG" || { echo "ERR: build failed" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 22; }; fi
fi
OUT_DIR=""
if [ -d build ]; then OUT_DIR=build; elif [ -d dist ]; then OUT_DIR=dist; fi
if [ -z "$OUT_DIR" ]; then echo "ERR: build output missing" >&2; exit 23; fi
START_CMD="npx serve -s \"$OUT_DIR\" -l $PORT"
LOG_START=/tmp/frontend-validate.start.$$.log
setsid bash -lc "export PORT=$PORT; exec $START_CMD" >"$LOG_START" 2>&1 &
SPID=$!
sleep 1
if [ -z "$SPID" ] || ! kill -0 "$SPID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERR: start failed" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG_START" >&2; exit 24; fi
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SPID" | tr -d ' ')
TRIES=12
OK=0
for i in $(seq 1 $TRIES); do
  sleep 1
  HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/frontend-validate.body.$$ -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ 2>/dev/null || echo 000)
  if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "000" ] && [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -lt 400 ]; then
    head -c 1024 /tmp/frontend-validate.body.$$ > "$RESP_FILE"
    echo "HTTP_STATUS=$HTTP_STATUS" > "$META_FILE"
    OK=1; break
  fi
  if [ "$i" -eq "$TRIES" ]; then echo "ERR: healthcheck failed (status=$HTTP_STATUS)" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG_START" >&2; kill -TERM -"${PGID}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 25; fi
done
kill -TERM -"${PGID}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 1
if kill -0 "$SPID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL -"${PGID}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
if [ "$OK" -ne 1 ]; then echo "ERR: validation failed" >&2; exit 26; fi
echo "VALIDATION_OK"
# evidence files
echo "evidence_files:$RESP_FILE,$META_FILE,$LOG_START"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
APPDIR="$WORKSPACE/app"
cd "$APPDIR"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
OUT_DIR=""
if [ -d build ]; then OUT_DIR=build; elif [ -d dist ]; then OUT_DIR=dist; else echo "ERR: build output missing" >&2; exit 23; fi

sleep 1

echo "$PGID" >/tmp/frontend-validate.pgid.$$.
echo "STARTED PID=$SPID PGID=$PGID LOG=$LOG_START"

output_scripts.name: stop
output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SPID_FILE=/tmp/frontend-validate.start.$$.
PGID_FILE=/tmp/frontend-validate.pgid.$$.
if [ -f "$PGID_FILE" ]; then
  PGID=$(cat "$PGID_FILE")
  kill -TERM -"${PGID}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 1
  if [ -f "$SPID_FILE" ]; then
    SPID=$(cat "$SPID_FILE")
    if kill -0 "$SPID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      kill -KILL -"${PGID}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
  fi
  rm -f "$PGID_FILE" "$SPID_FILE" || true
  echo "STOPPED"
else
  echo "NO_RUNNING_SERVER" >&2
  exit 1
fi
